ice-barrier.name: Ice Barrier
ice-barrier.desc: Shields you with ice, absorbing 172,825 damage for 1 min. Melee attacks against you reduce the attacker's movement speed by 50%.

alter-time.name: Alter Time
alter-time.desc: Alters the fabric of time, returning you to your current location and health when cast a second time, or after 10 sec. Effect negated by long distance or death.

ice-block.name: Ice Block
ice-block.desc: Encases you in a block of ice, protecting you from all attacks and damage for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells. Causes Hypothermia, preventing you from recasting Ice Block for 30 sec.

time-walk.name: Time Walk
time-walk.desc: Alter Time resets the cooldown of Blink and Shimmer when you return to your original location.

master-of-time.name: Master of Time
master-of-time.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Alter Time by 20 sec.

winter's-protection.name: Winter's Protection
winter's-protection.desc: The cooldown of Ice Block is reduced by 60 sec.

frost-conditioning.name: Frost Conditioning
frost-conditioning.desc: Hypothermia's duration is reduced by 10 sec.

inspired-intellect.name: Inspired Intellect
inspired-intellect.desc: Arcane Intellect grants you an additional 2% Intellect.

mirror-image.name: Mirror Image
mirror-image.desc: Creates 3 copies of you nearby for 15 sec, which cast spells and attack your enemies. While active, you generate significantly reduced threat. Taking direct damage will cause one of your images to dissipate.

spellsteal.name: Spellsteal
spellsteal.desc: Steals a beneficial magic effect from the target. This effect lasts a maximum of 2 min.

quick-witted.name: Quick Witted
quick-witted.desc: Counterspell's cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.

dragon's-breath.name: Dragon's Breath
dragon's-breath.desc: Enemies in a 12 yd cone in front of you take 98 Fire damage and are disoriented for 4 sec. Damage will cancel the effect.

remove-curse.name: Remove Curse
remove-curse.desc: Removes all Curses from a friendly target.

improved-conjuration.name: Improved Conjuration
improved-conjuration.desc: Mirror Image's cooldown is reduced by 120 sec.

improved-spellsteal.name: Improved Spellsteal
improved-spellsteal.desc: Spellsteal repeats its effect after 4 sec, but it now has a cooldown of 4.0 sec.

improved-blink.name: Improved Blink
improved-blink.desc: Blink's cooldown is reduced by 2 sec.

improved-counterspell.name: Improved Counterspell
improved-counterspell.desc: Counterspell prevents casting for an additional 1.0 sec.

overflowing-energy.name: Overflowing Energy
overflowing-energy.desc: Each time your Frostbolt fails to critically strike, it gains 10% increased critical strike chance. Critical strike bonus is removed when the affected spell critically strikes.

improved-remove-curse.name: Improved Remove Curse
improved-remove-curse.desc: Casting Remove Curse on a friendly target also casts it on yourself, but its cooldown is increased by 20 sec.

greater-invisibility.name: Greater Invisibility
greater-invisibility.desc: Makes you invisible and untargetable for 20 sec, removing all threat. Any action taken cancels this effect. Increases your movement speed by 80% for 6 sec.

improved-frost-nova.name: Improved Frost Nova
improved-frost-nova.desc: Frost Nova duration is increased by 2 sec.

captured-thoughts.name: Captured Thoughts
captured-thoughts.desc: The duration of Brain Freeze is increased by 15 sec.

incantation-of-swiftness.name: Incantation of Swiftness
incantation-of-swiftness.desc: Greater Invisibility increases your movement speed by 80% for 6 sec.

master-of-escape.name: Master of Escape
master-of-escape.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Invisibility by 60 sec.

charm-of-aegwynn.name: Charm of Aegwynn
charm-of-aegwynn.desc: The critical strike damage of your spells is increased by 5%.

brainstorm.name: Brainstorm
brainstorm.desc: Gaining Brain Freeze increases your Intellect by 1% for 8 sec. Multiple instances may overlap.

flow-of-time.name: Flow of Time
flow-of-time.desc: The cooldowns of Blink and Shimmer are reduced by 3 sec.

mana-confluence.name: Mana Confluence
mana-confluence.desc: Your mana costs are reduced by 5%.

permafrost-bauble.name: Permafrost Bauble
permafrost-bauble.desc: The cooldown of Ice Block and Ice Cold are reduced by 30 sec.

ice-nova.name: Ice Nova
ice-nova.desc: Causes a whirl of icy wind around the enemy, dealing 5,535 Frost damage to the target and all other enemies within 8 yds, freezing them in place for 2 sec. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

time-manipulation.name: Time Manipulation
time-manipulation.desc: The cooldowns of your loss of control spells are reduced by 5 sec.

ring-of-frost.name: Ring of Frost
ring-of-frost.meta: 2 sec cast · 30 yd range · 45 sec cooldown
ring-of-frost.desc: Summons a Ring of Frost for 10 sec at the target location. Enemies entering the ring are incapacitated for 10 sec. Limit 10 targets. When the incapacitate expires, enemies are slowed by 65% for 4 sec.

energized-barriers.name: Energized Barriers
energized-barriers.desc: Casting your barrier removes all snare effects.

mass-invisibility.name: Mass Invisibility
mass-invisibility.desc: You and your allies within 40 yards instantly become invisible for 12 sec. Taking any action will cancel the effect. Does not affect allies in combat.

barrier-diffusion.name: Barrier Diffusion
barrier-diffusion.desc: When your Barrier is removed, reduce its cooldown by 5 sec.

ice-cold.name: Ice Cold
ice-cold.desc: Ice Block now reduces all damage taken by 70% for 6 sec but no longer grants Immunity, prevents movement, attacks, or casting spells. Does not incur the Global Cooldown.

improved-ice-barrier.name: Improved Ice Barrier
improved-ice-barrier.desc: Ice Barrier gains an additional charge and reduces your physical damage taken by 10%.

ice-lance.name: Ice Lance
ice-lance.desc: Quickly fling a shard of ice at the target, dealing 8,227 Frost damage. Shatters 6 stacks of Freezing.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.meta: 2 sec cast · 40 yd range · 12 sec cooldown
blizzard.desc: Ice shards pelt the target area, dealing 23,142 Frost damage over 10.4 sec and reducing movement speed by 50% for 3 sec. This spell is cast at a selected location

fingers-of-frost.name: Fingers of Frost
fingers-of-frost.desc: Frostbolt has a 18% chance to grant a charge of Fingers of Frost. Fingers of Frost causes your next Ice Lance to deal Shatter damage equal to 5 stacks of Freezing and does not consume Freezing stacks. Maximum 2 charges.

frostbite.name: Frostbite
frostbite.desc: When Frostbolt critically strikes, it applies 1 additional stack of Freezing. Each stack of Freezing that you Shatter deals 1,183 damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

icicles.name: Icicles
icicles.desc: While in combat, Frost crystallizes around you, generating an Icicle every 5.2 sec. Upon generating 5 Icicles, Frostbolt upgrades to Glacial Spike for its next cast. Glacial Spike Conjures a massive spike of ice that impales your target, dealing 71,391 damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 50% for 8 sec. Applies 3 stacks of Freezing.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.desc: Unleash a flurry of ice, striking the target 4 times for a total of 30,006 Frost damage. Applies 4 stacks of Freezing.

glacial-bulwark.name: Glacial Bulwark
glacial-bulwark.desc: Ice Block now has an additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

frozen-orb.name: Frozen Orb
frozen-orb.desc: Launches an orb of swirling ice in front of you, dealing up to 83,080 Frost damage to all enemies it passes through over 15 sec. After a short delay, Frozen Orb will pursue its target. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets. Enemies damaged by the Frozen Orb are slowed by 50% for 8 sec.

brain-freeze.name: Brain Freeze
brain-freeze.desc: Frostfire Bolt has a 26.2% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Flurry and cause your next Flurry to deal 50% increased damage.

piercing-cold.name: Piercing Cold
piercing-cold.desc: Frostfire Bolt and Flurry critical strike damage increased by 20%.

ray-of-frost.name: Ray of Frost
ray-of-frost.desc: Channel an icy beam at the enemy for 3.5 sec, dealing 29,593 Frost damage every 0.43 sec. Applies 8 stacks of Freezing over its duration.

everlasting-frost.name: Everlasting Frost
everlasting-frost.desc: Casting Frozen Orb grants 1 stack of Fingers of Frost. Damaging one or more enemies with Frozen Orb has a 3% chance to grant Fingers of Frost.

permafrost-lances.name: Permafrost Lances
permafrost-lances.desc: Frozen Orb increases Shatter's damage by 10% for its duration.

frozen-touch.name: Frozen Touch
frozen-touch.desc: Frostbolt grants you Fingers of Frost 25% more often and Brain Freeze 20% more often.

splitting-ice.name: Splitting Ice
splitting-ice.desc: Your Flurry and Frostbolt spells strike 1 additional target at 50% effectiveness.

flash-freeze.name: Flash Freeze
flash-freeze.desc: Casting Glacial Spike has a 100% chance to grant you Fingers of Frost.

frigid-focus.name: Frigid Focus
frigid-focus.desc: Ray of Frost damage increased by 30%.

winter's-blessing.name: Winter's Blessing
winter's-blessing.desc: Your Haste is increased by 3%. You gain 5% more Haste from all sources of Haste.

freezing-rain.name: Freezing Rain
freezing-rain.desc: Frozen Orb makes Blizzard instant cast. Blizzard damage increased by 20%.

cone-of-frost.name: Cone of Frost
cone-of-frost.desc: Cone of Cold now applies 3 stacks of Freezing to up to 5 enemies.

fractured-frost.name: Fractured Frost
fractured-frost.desc: Ice Lance strikes 1 additional target at 50% effectiveness, preferring enemies with more stacks of Freezing.

improved-shatter.name: Improved Shatter
improved-shatter.desc: Shatter damage has a 50% increased chance to critically strike.

deep-shatter.name: Deep Shatter
deep-shatter.desc: Shatter's critical strike damage is increased by 50% of your critical strike chance.

wintertide.name: Wintertide
wintertide.desc: Frozen Orb has a 100% chance to grant Brain Freeze.

glacial-attunement.name: Glacial Attunement
glacial-attunement.desc: Flurry and Blizzard damage increased by 40%.

heart-of-ice.name: Heart of Ice
heart-of-ice.desc: Ice Lance Shatters 1 additional stack of Freezing.

rimecaster.name: Rimecaster
rimecaster.desc: Frostfire Bolt and Glacial Spike damage increased by 40%.

freezing-winds.name: Freezing Winds
freezing-winds.desc: Shattering enemies inside your Blizzard increases Shatter's area damage by 15%.

glacial-assault.name: Glacial Assault
glacial-assault.desc: Flurry has a 12% chance each hit to call down an icy comet, crashing into your target and nearby enemies for 6,576 Frost damage. Applies 1 stack of Freezing.

crystalline-refraction.name: Crystalline Refraction
crystalline-refraction.desc: Ray of Frost generates 2 stacks of Fingers of Frost over its duration.

summon-water-elemental.name: Summon Water Elemental
summon-water-elemental.desc: Summons a Water Elemental to follow and fight for you.

glacial-chill.name: Glacial Chill
glacial-chill.desc: Glacial Spike deals 5% increased damage and applies 2 additional stacks of Freezing.

hailstones.name: Hailstones
hailstones.desc: The time it takes to generate an Icicle is reduced by 1.0 sec.

thermal-void.name: Thermal Void
thermal-void.desc: Consuming Brain Freeze has a 100% chance to cause your next Ice Lance to Shatter 5 additional stacks of Freezing.

glaciate.name: Glaciate
glaciate.desc: When Ice Lance Shatters a stack of Freezing, the cooldown of Ray of Frost is reduced by 0.10 sec.

comet-storm.name: Comet Storm
comet-storm.desc: Casting Ray of Frost replaces your Ray of Frost with Comet Storm, calling down a series of 7 icy comets on and around the target, that deals up to 29,805 Frost damage to all enemies within 8 yds of its impacts. Each Comet Shatters 1 stack of Freezing.

hand-of-frost.name: Hand of Frost
hand-of-frost.desc: Rank 1: Shattering an enemy has a 10% chance to summon a Hand of Frost to pursue your target, dealing 16,039 Frost damage and applying 1 stack of Freezing on contact. Rank 3: Each stack of Freezing you Shatter increases your chance to summon a Hand of Frost by an additional 4.0%. Damage from Hand of Frost increases your spell damage by 2.0% for 8 sec. Multiple applications may overlap. Rank 4: Ray of Frost summons 4 Hands of Frost over its duration. Ray of Frost gains an additional charge and its damage is increased by 25%.

splintering-sorcery.name: Splintering Sorcery
splintering-sorcery.desc: Casting Frostbolt or Flurry conjures a Frost Splinter. Frost Splinter: Conjure raw Frost magic into a sharp projectile that deals 1,328 Frost damage.

augury-abounds.name: Augury Abounds
augury-abounds.desc: Conjuring one or more Frost Splinters has a 10% chance to conjure a burst of 8 Frost Splinters.

force-of-will.name: Force of Will
force-of-will.desc: Ice Lance conjures a Frost Splinter for every 2 Freezing stacks Shattered from its primary target.

splintering-orbs.name: Splintering Orbs
splintering-orbs.desc: Enemies damaged by your Frozen Orb conjure 1 Frost Splinter, up to 4. Frozen Orb damage is increased by 40%.

attuned-familiar.name: Attuned Familiar
attuned-familiar.desc: Your Water Elemental has a 50% chance to conjure a Splinter alongside its Waterbolt.

slippery-slinging.name: Slippery Slinging
slippery-slinging.desc: You have 40% increased movement speed during Alter Time.

controlled-instincts.name: Controlled Instincts
controlled-instincts.desc: 60% of the direct damage dealt by a Frost Splinter is also dealt to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

reactive-barrier.name: Reactive Barrier
reactive-barrier.desc: Your Ice Barrier can absorb up to 25% more damage based on your missing health. Max effectiveness when under 25% health.

infused-splinters.name: Infused Splinters
infused-splinters.desc: Direct damage from Frost Splinters have a 15% chance to apply 1 stack of Freezing.

archmage's-wrath.name: Archmage's Wrath
archmage's-wrath.desc: Ray of Frost damage increased by 20%. Your chance to gain Brain Freeze from Frostbolt is increased by 5%.

signature-spell.name: Signature Spell
signature-spell.desc: Frostbolt and Blizzard damage increased by 25%. Glacial Spike conjures 2 additional Frost Splinters.

spellfrost-teachings.name: Spellfrost Teachings
spellfrost-teachings.desc: Direct damage from Frost Splinters reduces the cooldown of Frozen Orb by 0.30 sec.

polished-focus.name: Polished Focus
polished-focus.desc: Ice Lance Shatters 1 additional stack of Freezing. Shatter damage increased by 20%.

splinterstorm.name: Splinterstorm
splinterstorm.desc: Each time Ray of Frost damages one or more enemies, it generates 1 Frost Splinter. For 10 sec after casting Ray of Frost, your chance to conjure an additional Frost Splinter is increased to 100%.

frostfire-bolt.name: Frostfire Bolt
frostfire-bolt.desc: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 9,653 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 50%, and causing an additional 804 Frostfire damage over 8 sec. Applies 1 stack of Freezing.

imbued-warding.name: Imbued Warding
imbued-warding.desc: Ice Barrier also casts a Blazing Barrier at 25% effectiveness.

frostfire-empowerment.name: Frostfire Empowerment
frostfire-empowerment.desc: Casting Frostfire spells has a 10% chance to activate Frostfire Empowerment, causing your next Frostfire Bolt to be instant cast, deal 60% increased damage, explode for 60% of its damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets. Damage from Frostfire Empowerment applies 1 stack of Freezing.

elemental-affinity.name: Elemental Affinity
elemental-affinity.desc: The cooldown of Fire spells is reduced by 30%.

duality.name: Duality
duality.desc: Casting Glacial Spike also casts a Pyroblast, dealing 25,155 Fire damage.

heat-sink.name: Heat Sink
heat-sink.desc: Flurry now deals Frostfire damage and its damage is increased by 25%.

thermal-conditioning.name: Thermal Conditioning
thermal-conditioning.desc: Frostfire Bolt's cast time is reduced by 10%.

dualcasting-adept.name: Dualcasting Adept
dualcasting-adept.desc: Your Fire spells deal 20% increased critical strike damage. Shatter damage increased by 40%. Blizzard damage increased by 15%.

molten-chill.name: Molten Chill
molten-chill.desc: Your Frostfire spells apply Ignite, dealing an additional 30% of their damage over 9 sec.

frostfire-infusion.name: Frostfire Infusion
frostfire-infusion.desc: Frostfire Bolt has an additional 5% chance to grant Brain Freeze. The damage of your Frost spells and Fire spells are increased by 4%.

flash-freezeburn.name: Flash Freezeburn
flash-freezeburn.desc: Glacial Spike damage increased by 15% and it now explodes on impact, dealing 25% of its damage to up to 5 nearby enemies. Additionally, Glacial Spike now grants Frostfire Empowerment.

blast-radius.name: Blast Radius
blast-radius.desc: Comet Storm damage increased by 50%. Meteor damage increased by 20%.

elemental-conduit.name: Elemental Conduit
elemental-conduit.desc: Meteor and Pyroblast now apply Ignite. Your Haste is increased by 2%.

isothermic-core.name: Isothermic Core
isothermic-core.desc: Comet Storm now also calls down a Meteor, dealing 35,840 Fire damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets. Damage from Meteor Shatters 1 stacks of Freezing.

icy-feet.name: Icy Feet
icy-feet.desc: When your Frost Nova or Water Elemental's Freeze is dispelled or removed, become immune to snares for 3 sec. This effect can only occur once every 10 sec.

concentrated-coolness.name: Concentrated Coolness
concentrated-coolness.desc: Frozen Orb's damage is increased by 10% and is now castable at a location with a 40 yard range but no longer moves.

ice-wall.name: Ice Wall
ice-wall.desc: Conjures an Ice Wall 30 yards long that obstructs line of sight. The wall has 30% of your maximum health and lasts up to 15 sec.

ring-of-fire.name: Ring of Fire
ring-of-fire.desc: Summons a Ring of Fire for 8 sec at the target location. Enemies entering the ring are disoriented and burn for 3% of their total health over 3 sec.

frost-bomb.name: Frost Bomb
frost-bomb.desc: Places a Frost Bomb on the target. After 5 sec, the bomb explodes, dealing 3,740 Frost damage to the target and 1,949 Frost damage to all other enemies within 10 yards. All affected targets are slowed by 50% for 8 sec. If Frost Bomb is dispelled before it explodes, gain a charge of Brain Freeze.

snowdrift.name: Snowdrift
snowdrift.desc: Summon a strong Blizzard that surrounds you for 6 sec that slows enemies by 70% and deals 82 Frost damage every 1 sec. Enemies that are caught in Snowdrift for 2 sec consecutively become Frozen in ice, stunned for 4 sec.

master-shepherd.name: Master Shepherd
master-shepherd.desc: While an enemy player is affected by your Polymorph or Mass Polymorph, your movement speed is increased by 25% and your Versatility is increased by 12%. Additionally, Polymorph and Mass Polymorph no longer heal enemies.

ethereal-blink.name: Ethereal Blink
ethereal-blink.desc: Blink and Shimmer apply Slow at 100% effectiveness to all enemies you Blink through. For each enemy you Blink through, the cooldown of Blink and Shimmer are reduced by 1 sec, up to 5 sec.

improved-mass-invisibility.name: Improved Mass Invisibility
improved-mass-invisibility.desc: The cooldown of Mass Invisibility is reduced by 4 min and can affect allies in combat.

overpowered-barrier.name: Overpowered Barrier
overpowered-barrier.desc: Your barriers absorb 100% more damage and have an additional effect, but last 4 sec. Prismatic Barrier If the barrier is fully absorbed, your next Blink or Shimmer within 15 sec grants Invisibility and immunity to damage for 3 sec. The damage reduction is lost if Invisibility ends.
